journey.name: Navigation State Retention - Tab Switch
journey.description:
Verifies that a top-level tab other than Home keeps its state while the user is on another tab: the submitted search query, the loaded results, the scroll position, and any sub-route pushed onto that tab must all be exactly as the user left them. Leaving a tab must not rebuild its screens from scratch (nubecita-owmt.2).
Works on any width. Run it folded (bottom navigation bar) and unfolded (navigation rail).

actions.action: Verify that the app is open on the Home feed
Tap the Search tab on the main navigation
Type a search query into the search input field and submit the search
Verify that post search results are displayed, and record the search query shown in the search field
Scroll the search results down slowly until the first result that was visible is off screen
Verify that search results are displayed, and record the text of the topmost fully visible result
Tap the Chats tab on the main navigation
Verify that the Chats screen is visible
Tap the Search tab on the main navigation
Verify that the search field still shows the recorded query, that search results are displayed without a loading indicator, and that the topmost fully visible result is the recorded one
Tap the topmost fully visible search result to open its detail screen
Verify that the post detail screen is visible
Tap the Notifications tab on the main navigation
Verify that the Notifications screen is visible
Tap the Search tab on the main navigation
Verify that the post detail screen for the same post is visible
Press the system back button
Verify that the search field still shows the recorded query and that the topmost fully visible result is the recorded one
Tap the You tab on the main navigation
Scroll the profile down slowly until the profile header is off screen
Verify that profile posts are displayed, and record the text of the topmost fully visible post
Tap the Home tab on the main navigation
Verify that the Home feed is visible
Tap the You tab on the main navigation
Verify that the profile header is still off screen and that the topmost fully visible post is the recorded one
